evidence_requests.question: Screen the current partition for unsupported internal splits and weak pair boundaries.

observations.meaning: Number of patients represented in each candidate set's structural calculation.
observations.finding: All four candidate sets have structural calculations covering their full membership (39, 31, 20, 13 patients).

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity among patients assigned to the same candidate set, reflecting internal cohesion in the four-view patient geometry.
observations.finding: Within-set affinity is uniformly low and tightly clustered across all four sets (range ~0.00941 to ~0.01009), with no set showing markedly higher internal cohesion than the others.

observations.meaning: Magnitude of the dominant spectral gap at the screened resolution for each set.
observations.finding: Each set's dominant gap occurs at the single-cluster resolution (screen_candidate_k=1), with the leading gap substantially larger than subsequent gaps in every set.

observations.meaning: Profile of spectral eigengaps across candidate resolutions within each set.
observations.finding: In every set the leading gap at k=1 dominates the remaining gaps by roughly two orders of magnitude, indicating the single-cluster resolution is dominant; this screening profile does not show a dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal.

observations.meaning: Algorithmic eigengap screening resolution for each set.
observations.finding: All four sets screen to candidate_k=1, so the partition-level screening does not identify a feasible multi-cluster subdivision for any set.

observations.meaning: Average fused affinity across each current pair boundary, identifying relatively close candidate pairs.
observations.finding: Between-set affinities are uniformly low (~0.00903 to ~0.00908) and nearly indistinguishable across the listed pairs; the closest pair is K4_C0002–K4_C0004, but the spread across all pairs is negligible, so these entries serve only as a pair-review entry point.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, these partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence about whether current memberships and boundaries are represented in the four-view patient geometry. The internal screen shows that each candidate set's dominant spectral gap sits at the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1), with the leading gap far exceeding subsequent gaps; per the metric semantics this describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure. Within-set affinities are uniformly low and tightly clustered, and between-set affinities are similarly low and nearly indistinguishable, so the current boundaries are not sharply separated in fused affinity geometry. No feasible k>=2 internal solutions are reported at this partition scope, so no set-level subdivision measurements are available to interpret. These observations describe representation and separation in the fused geometry only; they do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity and do not prescribe retention, split, or merge.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior Evidence Reports were supplied for this request, so there is no prior-report agreement or conflict to integrate.
limitations: Partition-level screening provides only triage evidence: it does not supply actual feasible k>=2 internal solutions, so internal substructure cannot be assessed from these results.
The uniformly low and closely spaced within- and between-set affinities limit discrimination among sets and pairs.
No reclustering was performed, and these structural measurements alone cannot establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the biological_support role, this set-versus-rest contrast characterizes whether K4_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable molecular phenotype. The analysis is estimable (19449 ranked genes; 39 vs 64 samples) and shows a coherent program: coordinated negative enrichment of oxidative phosphorylation together with interferon, complement, allograft-rejection, and IL6-JAK-STAT3 inflammatory pathways, all at the smallest adjusted q-values. The direction is consistently down relative to the rest of the partition, and the leading-edge gene sets overlap substantially across the immune pathways, indicating a shared inflammatory/immune signature rather than isolated pathway hits. This describes a coherent biological identity relative to the rest of the partition; it does not by itself establish that current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. Multiple measured factors show non-random association with candidate membership after multiple-testing correction: tissue_source_site (V~0.34, q=0.003), ct_phase (V~0.26, q=0.011), ct_manufacturer (V~0.27, q=0.011), ct_scanner_model (V~0.25, q=0.012), ct_reconstruction_kernel (V~0.21, q=0.026), and the continuous factors ct_slice_thickness (epsilon-squared~0.17, q<0.001) and ct_z_spacing (epsilon-squared~0.19, q<0.001). ct_pixel_spacing and study_year show no significant association. The contingency tables show substantial level imbalance across sets, so these factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed membership structure. These are associations only; they are not evidence of causal contribution, and the analysis does not perform covariate adjustment, so no claim of persistence after adjustment is made.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The present confounder associations are consistent with that picture in that several technical/acquisition factors co-vary with membership, which could contribute to the weak geometry; however, the two reports address different quantities (geometry vs factor association) and neither confirms nor refutes the other.
limitations: These are associations between measured factors and candidate membership; they do not establish causation or technical artifact.
No covariate adjustment or residualization was performed, so persistence of structure after accounting for these factors is not assessed.
Nonsignificance for ct_pixel_spacing and study_year does not establish absence of confounding by those factors.
The analysis covers only measured factors; unmeasured confounders are not addressed.
PERMANOVA/PERMDISP and continuous distance-regression results are not present in this tool output, so those specific confounder-exclusion checks cannot be interpreted here.

VHL is modestly enriched (OR~3.97, 95% CI 1.66-9.52; 29/39 vs 27/64; q_driver~0.010, q_global=1.0). BAP1 is depleted (OR~0.048, 95% CI 0.003-0.837; 0/39 vs 13/64; q_driver~0.010, q_global=1.0).

observations.meaning: Multiplicity-adjusted evidence for the remaining driver-panel genes; q_global spans the full tested-gene family.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the biological_support role, this set-versus-rest WXS contrast characterizes whether K4_C0001 has a coherent, interpretable molecular phenotype. The analysis is estimable (39 vs 64 samples; 3583 genes tested) and shows a coherent ccRCC-relevant mutation program: strong PBRM1 enrichment with concurrent VHL enrichment and BAP1 depletion, all within the prespecified driver panel. PBRM1 enrichment survives both driver-panel and global multiplicity correction (q_global~6.1e-7), whereas VHL and BAP1 survive only within the driver panel (q_driver~0.010) and not globally. The direction is coherent with a PBRM1-mutant/VHL-mutant, BAP1-wild-type pattern relative to the rest of the partition. This describes a coherent biological identity relative to the rest of the partition; it does not by itself establish that current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: A prior biological_support report for K4_C0001 (RNA pathway enrichment) described coordinated negative enrichment of oxidative phosphorylation together with interferon, complement, allograft-rejection, and IL6-JAK-STAT3 inflammatory pathways relative to the rest. The present WXS result addresses a different molecular layer (somatic mutation) and is not directly comparable in direction; both describe a coherent set-versus-rest phenotype, so they are concordant in indicating a distinguishable molecular identity for K4_C0001, though neither confirms the other's specific program. The partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic addresses geometry rather than molecular phenotype and neither agrees with nor conflicts with this result.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. Multiple measured factors show non-random association with candidate membership after multiple-testing correction: ct_phase (PERMANOVA q=0.0025, R2~0.154), ct_manufacturer (q=0.0067, R2~0.059), tissue_source_site in fused geometry (q=0.0025, R2~0.050), and the continuous factors ct_z_spacing (q=0.002, R2~0.142), ct_slice_thickness (q=0.002, R2~0.136), study_year (q=0.004, R2~0.029), and ct_pixel_spacing (q=0.035, R2~0.019). ct_reconstruction_kernel and ct_scanner_model are at the boundary (q=0.054) and do not retain q<0.05. For ct_manufacturer and ct_phase, PERMDISP is also significant, so their PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion; tissue_source_site shows no dispersion difference. The contingency tables show substantial level imbalance across sets, so these factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed membership structure. These are associations only; they are not evidence of causal contribution, and the analysis does not perform covariate adjustment, so no claim of persistence after adjustment is made.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The present confounder associations are consistent with that picture in that several technical/acquisition factors co-vary with membership, which could contribute to the weak geometry; however, the two reports address different quantities (geometry vs factor association) and neither confirms nor refutes the other. The prior confounder_association report (from an earlier wave) reported the same direction of association for these factors; the present PERMANOVA/PERMDISP and distance-regression results are concordant with that earlier association evidence, though the two use different test families and are not directly comparable.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, these partition structural diagnostics are triage evidence about whether current memberships and boundaries are represented in the four-view patient geometry. The internal screen shows that each candidate set's dominant spectral gap sits at the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1), with the leading gap far exceeding subsequent gaps; per the metric semantics this describes dominance of the single-cluster resolution and is not evidence of internal multi-cluster substructure. Within-set affinities are uniformly low and tightly clustered, and between-set affinities are similarly low and nearly indistinguishable, so the current boundaries are not sharply separated in fused affinity geometry. No feasible k>=2 internal solutions are reported at this partition scope, so no set-level subdivision measurements are available to interpret. These observations describe representation and separation in the fused geometry only; they do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity and do not prescribe retention, split, or merge.

observations.meaning: Paired patient bootstrap uncertainty interval and number of nondegenerate replicates.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, this set-versus-rest analysis evaluates whether K4_C0001 membership is represented in the four-view native patient geometry. Global GRV shows modest shared structure between modality geometries (significant for CT-WSI, RNA-WXS, WSI-RNA), but GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support. Overall, this provides limited geometric support for treating K4_C0001 as a separately represented unit; the set-versus-rest interpretation is limited by a potentially heterogeneous rest group. No reclustering was performed, and these structural measurements do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The prior biological_support reports (RNA pathway enrichment and WXS mutation enrichment) describe a coherent molecular phenotype for K4_C0001, which addresses a different quantity (molecular phenotype vs geometry) and neither confirms nor refutes the geometric representation.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. Multiple measured factors show non-random association with candidate membership after multiple-testing correction: tissue_source_site (V~0.34, q=0.003), ct_phase (V~0.26, q=0.011), ct_manufacturer (V~0.27, q=0.011), ct_scanner_model (V~0.25, q=0.012), ct_reconstruction_kernel (V~0.21, q=0.026), and the continuous factors ct_slice_thickness (epsilon-squared~0.17, q<0.001) and ct_z_spacing (epsilon-squared~0.19, q<0.001). ct_pixel_spacing and study_year show no significant association. The contingency tables show substantial level imbalance across sets, so these factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed membership structure. These are associations only; they are not evidence of causal contribution, and the analysis does not perform covariate adjustment, so no claim of persistence after adjustment is made.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The present confounder associations are consistent with that picture in that several technical/acquisition factors co-vary with membership, which could contribute to the weak geometry; however, the two reports address different quantities (geometry vs factor association) and neither confirms nor refutes the other.
limitations: These are associations between measured factors and candidate membership; they do not establish causation or technical artifact.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. Multiple measured factors show non-random association with candidate membership after multiple-testing correction: ct_phase (PERMANOVA q=0.0025, R2~0.154), ct_manufacturer (q=0.0067, R2~0.059), tissue_source_site in fused geometry (q=0.0025, R2~0.050), and the continuous factors ct_z_spacing (q=0.002, R2~0.142), ct_slice_thickness (q=0.002, R2~0.136), study_year (q=0.004, R2~0.029), and ct_pixel_spacing (q=0.035, R2~0.019). ct_reconstruction_kernel and ct_scanner_model are at the boundary (q=0.054) and do not retain q<0.05. For ct_manufacturer and ct_phase, PERMDISP is also significant, so their PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion; tissue_source_site shows no dispersion difference. The contingency tables show substantial level imbalance across sets, so these factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed membership structure. These are associations only; they are not evidence of causal contribution, and the analysis does not perform covariate adjustment, so no claim of persistence after adjustment is made.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The present confounder associations are consistent with that picture in that several technical/acquisition factors co-vary with membership, which could contribute to the weak geometry; however, the two reports address different quantities (geometry vs factor association) and neither confirms nor refutes the other. The prior confounder_association report (from an earlier wave) reported the same direction of association for these factors; the present PERMANOVA/PERMDISP and distance-regression results are concordant with that earlier association evidence, though the two use different test families and are not directly comparable.
limitations: These are associations between measured factors and candidate membership; they do not establish causation or technical artifact.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, this set-versus-rest analysis evaluates whether K4_C0001 membership is represented in the four-view native patient geometry. Current-label alignment is weak: silhouette values are near zero for CT and WSI and small for RNA and WXS, and within-set versus between-set mean distances are nearly indistinguishable in every modality, indicating little geometric distinction between K4_C0001 and the rest. Global GRV shows modest shared structure between modality geometries (significant for CT-WSI, RNA-WXS, WSI-RNA), but GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support. Overall, this provides limited geometric support for treating K4_C0001 as a separately represented unit; the set-versus-rest interpretation is limited by a potentially heterogeneous rest group. No reclustering was performed, and these structural measurements do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the biological_support role, this set-versus-rest WXS contrast characterizes whether K4_C0003 has a coherent, interpretable molecular phenotype. The analysis is estimable (20 vs 83 samples; 3583 genes tested) and shows a coherent ccRCC-relevant mutation pattern: strong BAP1 enrichment, which survives both driver-panel and global multiplicity correction (q_global~0.0059). VHL and PBRM1 show no adjusted evidence. The direction is coherent with a BAP1-mutant pattern relative to the rest of the partition, which is distinct from the PBRM1/VHL pattern of K4_C0001 and the VHL/PBRM1-depleted pattern of K4_C0002. This describes a coherent biological identity relative to the rest of the partition; it does not by itself establish that current membership or granularity deserves independent retention.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: A prior biological_support report for K4_C0003 (RNA pathway enrichment) described strong positive enrichment of allograft rejection, interferon alpha/gamma response, IL6-JAK-STAT3 signaling, inflammatory response, and complement relative to the rest. The present WXS result addresses a different molecular layer (somatic mutation) and is not directly comparable in direction; both describe a coherent set-versus-rest phenotype, so they are concordant in indicating a distinguishable molecular identity for K4_C0003, though neither confirms the other's specific program. The partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic addresses geometry rather than molecular phenotype and neither agrees with nor conflicts with this result.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. Multiple measured factors show non-random association with candidate membership after multiple-testing correction: ct_phase (PERMANOVA q=0.0025, R2~0.154), ct_manufacturer (q=0.0067, R2~0.059), tissue_source_site in fused geometry (q=0.0025, R2~0.050), and the continuous factors ct_z_spacing (q=0.002, R2~0.142), ct_slice_thickness (q=0.002, R2~0.136), study_year (q=0.004, R2~0.029), and ct_pixel_spacing (q=0.035, R2~0.019). ct_reconstruction_kernel and ct_scanner_model are at the boundary (q=0.054) and do not retain q<0.05. For ct_manufacturer and ct_phase, PERMDISP is also significant, so their PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion; tissue_source_site shows no dispersion difference. The contingency tables show substantial level imbalance across sets, so these factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed membership structure. These are associations only; they are not evidence of causal contribution, and the analysis does not perform covariate adjustment, so no claim of persistence after adjustment is made.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The present confounder associations are consistent with that picture in that several technical/acquisition factors co-vary with membership, which could contribute to the weak geometry; however, the two reports address different quantities (geometry vs factor association) and neither confirms nor refutes the other. The prior confounder_association report (from an earlier wave) reported the same direction of association for these factors; the present PERMANOVA/PERMDISP and distance-regression results are concordant with that earlier association evidence, though the two use different test families and are not directly comparable.
limitations: These are associations between measured factors and candidate membership; they do not establish causation or technical artifact.
No covariate adjustment or residualization was performed, so persistence of structure after accounting for these factors is not assessed.
PERMANOVA, PERMDISP, and continuous distance-regression p-values belong to separate BH families and must not be conflated.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, this set-versus-rest analysis evaluates whether K4_C0001 membership is represented in the four-view native patient geometry. Current-label alignment is weak: silhouette values are near zero for CT and WSI and small for RNA and WXS, and within-set versus between-set mean distances are nearly indistinguishable in every modality, indicating little geometric distinction between K4_C0001 and the rest. Global GRV shows modest shared structure between modality geometries (significant for CT-WSI, RNA-WXS, WSI-RNA), but GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support. Overall, this provides limited geometric support for treating K4_C0001 as a separately represented unit; the set-versus-rest interpretation is limited by a potentially heterogeneous rest group. No reclustering was performed, and these structural measurements do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

observations.meaning: Paired patient bootstrap uncertainty interval and number of nondegenerate replicates.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, this set-versus-rest analysis evaluates whether K4_C0001 membership is represented in the four-view native patient geometry. Current-label alignment is weak: silhouette values are near zero for CT and WSI and small for RNA and WXS, and within-set versus between-set mean distances are nearly indistinguishable in every modality, indicating little geometric distinction between K4_C0001 and the rest. Global GRV shows modest shared structure between modality geometries (significant for CT-WSI, RNA-WXS, WSI-RNA), but GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support. Overall, this provides limited geometric support for treating K4_C0001 as a separately represented unit; the set-versus-rest interpretation is limited by a potentially heterogeneous rest group. No reclustering was performed, and these structural measurements do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The prior biological_support reports (RNA pathway enrichment and WXS mutation enrichment) describe a coherent molecular phenotype for K4_C0001, which addresses a different quantity (molecular phenotype vs geometry) and neither confirms nor refutes the geometric representation.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. Multiple measured factors show non-random association with candidate membership after multiple-testing correction: ct_phase (PERMANOVA q=0.0025, R2~0.154), ct_manufacturer (q=0.0067, R2~0.059), tissue_source_site in fused geometry (q=0.0025, R2~0.050), and the continuous factors ct_z_spacing (q=0.002, R2~0.142), ct_slice_thickness (q=0.002, R2~0.136), study_year (q=0.004, R2~0.029), and ct_pixel_spacing (q=0.035, R2~0.019). ct_reconstruction_kernel and ct_scanner_model are at the boundary (q=0.054) and do not retain q<0.05. For ct_manufacturer and ct_phase, PERMDISP is also significant, so their PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion; tissue_source_site shows no dispersion difference. The contingency tables show substantial level imbalance across sets, so these factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed membership structure. These are associations only; they are not evidence of causal contribution, and the analysis does not perform covariate adjustment, so no claim of persistence after adjustment is made.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The present confounder associations are consistent with that picture in that several technical/acquisition factors co-vary with membership, which could contribute to the weak geometry; however, the two reports address different quantities (geometry vs factor association) and neither confirms nor refutes the other. The prior confounder_association report (from an earlier wave) reported the same direction of association for these factors; the present PERMANOVA/PERMDISP and distance-regression results are concordant with that earlier association evidence, though the two use different test families and are not directly comparable.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the confounder_exclusion role, these partition-level analyses evaluate whether measured technical, acquisition, or site factors remain plausible alternative explanations for the observed candidate structure. Multiple measured factors show non-random association with candidate membership after multiple-testing correction: ct_phase (PERMANOVA q=0.0025, R2~0.154), ct_manufacturer (q=0.0067, R2~0.059), tissue_source_site in fused geometry (q=0.0025, R2~0.050), and the continuous factors ct_z_spacing (q=0.002, R2~0.142), ct_slice_thickness (q=0.002, R2~0.136), study_year (q=0.004, R2~0.029), and ct_pixel_spacing (q=0.035, R2~0.019). ct_reconstruction_kernel and ct_scanner_model are at the boundary (q=0.054) and do not retain q<0.05. For ct_manufacturer and ct_phase, PERMDISP is also significant, so their PERMANOVA may reflect both location and dispersion; tissue_source_site shows no dispersion difference. The contingency tables show substantial level imbalance across sets, so these factors remain plausible alternative explanations for part of the observed membership structure. These are associations only; they are not evidence of causal contribution, and the analysis does not perform covariate adjustment, so no claim of persistence after adjustment is made.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported uniformly low within- and between-set affinities and no dominant multi-cluster subdivision signal, i.e., weak geometric separation. The present confounder associations are consistent with that picture in that several technical/acquisition factors co-vary with membership, which could contribute to the weak geometry; however, the two reports address different quantities (geometry vs factor association) and neither confirms nor refutes the other. The prior confounder_association report (from an earlier wave) reported the same direction of association for these factors; the present PERMANOVA/PERMDISP and distance-regression results are concordant with that earlier association evidence, though the two use different test families and are not directly comparable.

The contingency tables nonetheless show substantial level imbalance (e.g., absence of B0/CJ and depletion of UNKNOWN), so these factors cannot be dismissed as alternative explanations on the basis of this analysis. These are associations only; no covariate adjustment or residualization was performed, so no claim of persistence after adjustment is made, and nonsignificance does not establish absence of confounding.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: The prior partition-level confounder_association report (earlier wave) reported non-random association of several factors with candidate membership across the partition, and the prior confounder_representation_effect report (PERMANOVA/PERMDISP) reported significant location associations for ct_phase, ct_manufacturer, tissue_source_site, and continuous acquisition factors. The present set-level result for K4_C0004 is concordant in direction for ct_phase (nominal association) but does not retain significance after correction at this set scope; the two use different test families and scopes and are not directly comparable. The partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported weak geometric separation, which is consistent with technical factors co-varying with membership, though the two address different quantities.
limitations: These are associations between measured factors and candidate membership; they do not establish causation or technical artifact.
No covariate adjustment or residualization was performed, so persistence of structure after accounting for these factors is not assessed.
Nonsignificance for all factors at this set scope does not establish absence of confounding.

evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, this pair-scope analysis evaluates whether the existing boundary between K4_C0002 and K4_C0004 is represented in the four-view native patient geometry. Current-label alignment directly addresses this: silhouettes are essentially zero for CT (0.006), RNA (-0.001), and WSI (0.002), and within-set versus between-set mean distances are nearly indistinguishable in those modalities, indicating little geometric distinction between the two current candidate sets. Only WXS shows a modest silhouette (0.246) with smaller within-set than between-set distance, so the boundary is expressed to a limited degree in the WXS geometry alone. Global GRV is modest across modality pairs and significant only for WSI-RNA, but GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, this pair-scope analysis evaluates whether the existing boundary between K4_C0002 and K4_C0003 is represented in the four-view native patient geometry. Current-label alignment directly addresses this: silhouettes are small in all four modalities (CT 0.143, RNA 0.052, WSI 0.063, WXS 0.055), and within-set mean distance is smaller than between-set mean distance in every modality, with the clearest relative distinction in CT. This indicates that the current K4_C0002/K4_C0003 boundary is expressed only weakly and inconsistently across modalities, with no modality showing a strong separation. Global GRV is modest across modality pairs and significant for four of six pairs, but GRV describes global patient-geometry similarity and is not itself current-boundary support. Overall, this provides limited geometric support for the current K4_C0002/K4_C0003 boundary; weak pair separation does not recommend merge, and no reclustering was performed. These structural measurements do not establish biological meaning or clinical validity.

The prior set-level affinity_geometry_concordance reports found weak-to-modest alignment for K4_C0002 (larger WXS silhouette 0.177) and weak-to-modest alignment for K4_C0003 (silhouettes 0.035 to 0.098), consistent with the weak boundary seen here. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the cross_modal_consistency role, this pair-scope structural diagnostic addresses whether the current K4_C0002/K4_C0003 boundary and the internal structure of their union are represented in the fused four-view patient geometry. Current-boundary separation is essentially absent: the boundary silhouette is near zero (~0.00057) and within-set affinity (~0.00957) is nearly indistinguishable from between-set affinity (~0.00903), so the existing labels are not expressed as a distinct boundary in fused affinity geometry. Per the scope interpretation, a weak current boundary together with a single-cluster-dominated union is structurally compatible with removing the boundary; however, this is not sufficient by itself to justify merge, and weak pair separation does not recommend merge. evidence_reports.dimension_interpretation: Within the known_label_echo role, this partition-level analysis describes how the current candidate sets correspond to available clinical stratification and to previously reported ccRCC taxonomies. Clinical correspondence is modest and selective: grade is the only clinical variable with a non-random association (V~0.21, p=0.015), driven partly by G4 concentration in K4_C0003; M stage, overall stage, and T stage show small-to-negligible associations that do not reach the nominal threshold, and the only per-set M-stage difference is a nominal, uncorrected K4_C0003 signal. Taxonomy correspondence is weak for both reference taxonomies (ClearCode34 ARI~0.15/AMI~0.18; TCGA m1-m4 ARI~0.086/AMI~0.068), with only partial directional concentration (ccA/m1 in K4_C0001, ccB/m3 in K4_C0003). Per the role guidance, these are correspondence measurements only: they do not establish novelty, validity, independence, or retention, and the taxonomy comparisons overlap the RNA discovery view and are not independent validation.
evidence_reports.cross_evidence_context: No prior known_label_echo report was supplied for this request, so there is no prior-report agreement or conflict to integrate for this dimension. The prior reports address other dimensions: the partition-level cross_modal_consistency structural diagnostic reported weak geometric separation, and the biological_support reports (RNA pathway enrichment and WXS mutation enrichment) described coherent set-versus-rest molecular phenotypes. Those address different quantities (geometry and molecular phenotype) and neither confirm nor refute the clinical/taxonomy correspondence reported here.
